policies.sentence: Students should use AI only as they would a friend, classmate, or outside helper.
Using AI is like getting help from a friend who took the class or an extra team member.
AI use is treated like use of other online resources or located information.
The collaboration policy applies equally to AI tools; AI is permitted only where collaboration is allowed.
Students must not use AI, which counts as unauthorized collaboration or an unacceptable outside source.
Students may use AI as a collaborator, consultant, or limited helper.
Students may and are encouraged to discuss ideas and concepts with peers, staff, and other people.
Students must cite and credit all sources, including AI, with quotation marks and citations.
Students must not share, view, discuss, or receive detailed code or solutions with other people.
The course's philosophy on academic honesty is to be reasonable.
Students must treat generative AI tools the same way as any other resource or external source.
